episode.title: MORE Stories That Should be Films
episode.tagline: There is a man who steals the electricity bills of everyone in his apartment block. Why? Can he find love and redemption? Two young Sikhs take a stand defending a bridge. Why? What do they really want? Two great chess players take each other on. Are they playing the game on the board, or some other game? There is a child in the mail. What? A child in the MAIL?
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay lay out four more stories that should be films. Great fun -- and much to think about!
